# Concrete: Here you can find garden gnomes and cement bags for the challenges

![Concrete: Here you can find garden gnomes and cement bags for the challenges](/uploads/317_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In the daily and weekly challenges we regularly encounter the task of recycling scrap to obtain concrete. Or maybe you just want to farm concrete for your camp. Here you will find suitable scrap items from which you can get concrete, as well as a map of all scrap items that contain concrete.

## Scrap items containing concrete

- Bag of cement
- Large amount of concrete
- Concrete scrap
- Blue garden gnome
- Red garden gnome

## Card with concrete & garden gnomes

![Map with concrete and garden gnomes](/uploads/nukaknights-cement-garden-gnomes-locations-map-1280.jpg)
